description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating nested integer tuples, including type checks, structure matching, flattening, mathematical operations, coordinate transformations, and slicing, used within the PyTorch distributed package.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Checks if the object is an Integer type.

methods.name: is_tuple
methods.description: Checks if the object is a tuple.

methods.name: as_tuple
methods.description: Converts an IntTuple to a tuple of IntTuples.

methods.name: match_structure
methods.description: Recursively checks if two IntTuples have the same nested structure.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens a nested IntTuple into a tuple of integers.

methods.name: signum
methods.description: Returns the sign of an integer.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Calculates the product of all integers in an IntTuple.

methods.name: inner_product
methods.description: Computes the inner product of two IntTuples.

methods.name: tuple_max
methods.description: Finds the maximum integer in an IntTuple.

methods.name: elem_scale
methods.description: Scales elements of an IntTuple by corresponding elements or products.

methods.name: shape_div
methods.description: Performs inclusive division of shape dimensions with ceiling.

methods.name: suffix_product
methods.description: Calculates suffix (lexicographic) product of an IntTuple.

methods.name: idx2crd
methods.description: Converts a linear index to coordinate in a shape with optional stride.

methods.name: crd2idx
methods.description: Converts coordinates to a linear index based on shape and stride.

methods.name: crd2crd
methods.description: Transforms coordinates between different shape spaces.

methods.name: slice_
methods.description: Filters elements based on coordinate slices, handling None values.

methods.name: has_none
methods.description: Checks if an IntTuple or nested structure contains None.
